items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: then I put the hot ...I put the Black and Tan in there.

ctx.x: I see. Paul Howard was just in the band.
He was in the band. Yeah. After Mutt 'n' left 'n' them--we had a little disagreement and they left--then I put the hot ...I put the Black and Tan in there.
And the next...how long did you have the Dreamland?

items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: Reb never played with us. He got mad.

ctx.x: Reb Spikes? Was he in there?
No, uh-huh. Reb never played with us. He got mad.
And according to this, you left the Black and Tan Orchestra in 1923?
